items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Chick Webb had a beautiful band but Fletcher and Duke, they was the kings.

ctx.x: '33. Amongst the guys of the bands you were in at that time, who's band was considered the best of the big bands?

Well, it was a toss-up between Duke and Fletcher. You see, Fletcher had a stomp band, see, Fletcher and they would battle had a stomp band and Fletcher would come up there/every year, you know. Chick Webb had a beautiful band but Fletcher and Duke, they was the kings. They was the kings.
Now, you met Ellington during those years?
